title: Add chat transcript and feedback data plane for fine-tuning
description: Create durable chat transcript + thumbs feedback capture with retention/redaction controls so MemorySmith can produce high-quality supervised and preference datasets from real usage.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from critical pre-implementation review. This is a prerequisite for any meaningful SFT/DPO/ORPO pipeline because current chat history is effectively client-local and non-durable.
